cards.ex: I always shop around online before buying anything expensive.
cards.exUz: Men har doim qimmat narsa sotib olishdan oldin onlaynda taqqoslash qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi narxni topish uchun turli do'konlarda qidirish.

cards.ex: That restaurant is a total rip-off; the food isn't even good.
cards.exUz: Bu restoran to'liq talonchilik; ovqat hatto mazali ham emas.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari qimmat narxda sotiladigan narsa.

cards.ex: It's getting harder and harder to make ends meet with these rising prices.
cards.exUz: Ushbu o'sib borayotgan narxlar bilan kun ko'rish tobora qiyinlashmoqda.

cards.ex: We're on a tight budget this month, so we can't go out to eat.
cards.exUz: Biz bu oy qattiq byudjetdamiz, shuning uchun biz ovqatlanishga chiqa olmaymiz.

cards.ex: I'm completely broke until payday.
cards.exUz: Men oylikkacha butunlay cho'ntak quruqman.

cards.ex: We're going to have to tighten our belts if we want to save for a house.
cards.exUz: Agar uy uchun pul yig'moqchi bo'lsak, kamarlarimizni mahkam bog'lashimiz kerak.

cards.ex: My boss offered to foot the bill for the business lunch.
cards.exUz: Boshlig'im ishbilarmonlik tushligi uchun to'lovni to'lashni taklif qildi.

cards.ex: This new phone is expensive, but it's worth every penny.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi telefon qimmat, lekin u har bir tiyinga arziydi.
cards.uzDef: Narxi qimmat bo'lsa ham, bunga arziydi.

cards.ex: I decided to splash out on a new laptop.
cards.exUz: Men yangi noutbukga pul sochishga qaror qildim.

cards.ex: We went window shopping downtown to see what's new.
cards.exUz: Biz markazga yangiliklarni ko'rish uchun vitrinalarni tomosha qilishga bordik.
cards.uzDef: Sotib olmasdan do'kon vitrinalarini tomosha qilish.

cards.ex: We live in a consumer society where people are constantly buying new things.
cards.exUz: Biz odamlar doimo yangi narsalarni sotib oladigan iste'mol jamiyatida yashaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p narsalarni sotib olishga asoslangan jamiyat.

cards.ex: Don't be such a cheapskate; it's your turn to buy the drinks.
cards.exUz: Bunday xisna bo'lma; ichimliklarni sotib olish navbati senga.

cards.ex: Let's just go Dutch on the bill.
cards.exUz: Keling, to'lovda har kim o'zi to'lasin.
cards.uzDef: Har bir kishi o'z hissasini to'laydi.

cards.ex: He made some easy money selling his old comics online.
cards.exUz: U eski komikslarini onlayn sotib, oson pul topdi.

cards.ex: This antique table was a steal at that price.
cards.exUz: Bu antiqa stol ushbu narxda arzon topilma edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda arzon narxda sotib olingan narsa.

cards.ex: I want to get my money's worth out of this gym membership.
cards.exUz: Men bu sport zaliga a'zolikdan pulimga arziydigan narsa olishni xohlayman.

cards.ex: That product has become a real cash cow for the company.
cards.exUz: Bu mahsulot kompaniya uchun haqiqiy daromad manbaiga aylandi.

cards.ex: These shoes are on sale this week.
cards.exUz: Bu poyabzallar shu hafta chegirmada.

cards.ex: That dress was an impulse buy; I didn't really need it.
cards.exUz: Bu ko'ylak o'ylab o'tirmay sotib olingan narsa edi; menga haqiqatan ham kerak emas edi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylab o'tirmay, birdaniga sotib olingan narsa.

cards.ex: I'm saving up for a new car.
cards.exUz: Men yangi mashina uchun pul yig'yapman.

cards.ex: The company went bankrupt after losing a major contract.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yirik shartnomani yo'qotganidan keyin bankrot bo'ldi.

cards.ex: It's difficult to live in this city on a minimum wage; we need a living wage.
cards.exUz: Bu shaharda minimal ish haqi bilan yashash qiyin; bizga tirikchilik puli kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hayot uchun zarur bo'lgan minimal pul miqdori.

cards.ex: Good cash flow is essential for a successful business.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi pul oqimi muvaffaqiyatli biznes uchun juda muhimdir.

cards.ex: I had to get a loan to buy my first house.
cards.exUz: Men birinchi uyimni sotib olish uchun kredit olishga majbur bo'ldim.

cards.ex: We need to cut costs in order to stay profitable.
cards.exUz: Biz foydali bo'lib qolish uchun xarajatlarni kamaytirishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: This car is great value for money; it's reliable and affordable.
cards.exUz: Bu mashina narxiga ajoyib arziydi; u ishonchli va arzon.
cards.uzDef: To'langan pulga nisbatan sifatli mahsulot yoki xizmat.

cards.ex: They have a nice nest egg saved up for retirement.
cards.exUz: Ularning pensiya uchun yaxshi qora kun uchun puli bor.

cards.ex: They're trying to cash in on the popularity of the new movie.
cards.exUz: Ular yangi filmni mashhurligidan foyda ko'rishga harakat qilishmoqda.

cards.ex: That sports car is way beyond my means.
cards.exUz: Bu sport mashinasi mening imkoniyatimdan ancha tashqari.

cards.ex: I can't buy you everything you want, you know. Money doesn't grow on trees!
cards.exUz: Men siz xohlagan hamma narsani sotib ololmayman, bilasiz. Pul daraxtda o'smaydi!
cards.uzDef: Pulni topish qiyin degan ma'noda ishlatiladi.
